unit.why: A short narrative, told by the author's teacher: the Maggid of Mezeritch asks Heaven for the scholar of the generation and then arranges the match of his son with R. Feivel of Kamenitz's daughter.

stories.start_quote: קכג עוד שמעתי ממנו ז"ל פ"א
stories.summary_en: While studying a passage on eating terumah of hametz on Passover, the rebbe asks for the book Mishnat Hakhamim and tells how the Maggid of Mezeritch asked Heaven who was the scholar of the generation, so he could match his son R. Abraham the Angel with that scholar's daughter. Heaven named R. Feivel of Kamenitz, the author of that book, and the match was made.

quotes: בכדי לשדך עמו וליתן בת ת"ח שבדור לבנו
tags.why: arranging a match is the plot
the Maggid's son is the groom

tags.why: a heavenly disclosure names the scholar

quotes: וסיפר אשר הה״ק מהד״ב ז"ל שאל
